title: Voltage-Controlled Oscillator Model
constraints: Output frequency `f = F0 + KVCO · vctrl` (Hz), clamped to [1 MHz, 1 GHz].
`clk_out` is a 50 % duty-cycle square wave starting at 0. It toggles every `1 / (2f)` seconds, using the `vctrl` value at the moment of each toggle.
Measured frequency must be within 0.5 % and duty cycle within 45 – 55 %. A second instance uses `F0 = 20 MHz`, `KVCO = 10 MHz/V`.
SystemVerilog: keep `` `timescale 1ns / 1ps `` so that `#` delays are in nanoseconds. Behavioral model, not synthesizable.
hints: SystemVerilog: an `always` block with no event control, containing `#(half_period_ns) clk_out = ~clk_out;`, is a free-running oscillator.
Half period in ns is `0.5e9 / f` when the timescale is 1 ns.
VHDL: `wait for (0.5 / f) * 1 sec;` turns a real number of seconds into a `time`.
